dialogue.origin: 本日はどうぞよろしくお願いします
dialogue.content: Thank you for coming in today. I look forward to our session.

dialogue.origin: よろしくおねがいいたします、
dialogue.content: Thank you for having me.

dialogue.origin: もし準備よろしければ、始めても大丈夫でしょうか？
dialogue.content: If you're ready, shall we begin?

dialogue.origin: はい大丈夫ですお願いします。
dialogue.content: Yes, I'm ready. Please go ahead.

dialogue.origin: 有難うございます
dialogue.content: Thank you.

dialogue.origin: こんばんは相談員ですはじめに年齢と性別、何とお呼びしたらいいか教えていただけますか
dialogue.content: Good evening, I'm the counselor. To start, could you please tell me your age, gender, and what you would like me to call you?

dialogue.origin: 15歳中学３年女子です。あかねでお願いします。
dialogue.content: I'm a 15-year-old girl in my third year of junior high school. Please call me Akane.

dialogue.origin: あかねさんですね、有難うございます
dialogue.content: Akane, got it. Thank you.

dialogue.origin: よろしくお願いします
dialogue.content: Thank you.

dialogue.origin: よろしくお願いします本日はどのようなご相談でしょうか
dialogue.content: You're welcome. What brings you in today?

dialogue.origin: 塾で一緒になる人のことを好きになったのですが、どうしたらよいか悩んでいます。
dialogue.content: I've developed a crush on someone at my cram school, and I'm not sure what to do about it.

dialogue.origin: それは大切なお話ですよねその人はどんな方なのでしょうか？
dialogue.content: That sounds important. Could you tell me a little about this person?

dialogue.origin: 塾で一緒なだけで話したことはないです。
dialogue.content: We're in the same cram school, but we've never spoken.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね、一目惚れという感じでしょうか
dialogue.content: I see. Is it like love at first sight?

dialogue.origin: 前から気になっていたのですが、先月付き合っていた彼と別れて、落ち込んでいたのですが、そのままだとダメになってしまうと思って、新しい恋をしようと思ったことがきっかけです。
dialogue.content: I'd noticed him for a while, but I broke up with my boyfriend last month and was feeling down. I felt like I couldn't go on like that and needed to move on, so I decided to look for a new love, and that's what started this.

dialogue.origin: 前の彼氏さんと別れて、、そんなことがあったのですね、、頑張って次の恋を探していたのですね
dialogue.content: You broke up with your previous boyfriend... That must have been tough. You're trying hard to find a new love.

dialogue.origin: はいそうなんです。
dialogue.content: Yes, that's right.

dialogue.origin: 今好きになっている人に対して悩んでいるということですが、どんなことが気になっていますか
dialogue.content: You mentioned you're worried about the person you like now. What specifically is on your mind?

dialogue.origin: 話したことがないのですが、このままだと、卒業して塾も終わってしまうので、やだなと。
dialogue.content: We've never talked, and I'm worried that if things stay this way, we'll graduate and cram school will end, and that will be it. I don't want that.

dialogue.origin: このまま思いを伝えられないで、終わってしまうのは悲しいですよね、、
dialogue.content: It would be sad if it ended without you ever getting to tell him how you feel, wouldn't it?

dialogue.origin: はい、そうなんです。
dialogue.content: Yes, exactly.

dialogue.origin: うんうん、今は思いを伝えたい気持ちが強いのでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Mm-hm. Do you have a strong desire to tell him how you feel right now?

dialogue.origin: わかって欲しいという思いはつよいですが、告白とかはどうなんだろうかと。
dialogue.content: I really want him to know, but I'm not sure about actually confessing.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね、好きな気持ちはあるけど、告白までは勇気が出ない感じなんですね、、
dialogue.content: I see. So you have feelings for him, but you can't quite work up the courage to confess.

dialogue.origin: はい、本当に話したこともなくて・・しかも受験だし
dialogue.content: Yes, we've really never even talked... and on top of that, it's exam season.

dialogue.origin: でも、このままだと、ほんとうにこのままで終わってしまう・・
dialogue.content: But if I do nothing, it will really just end like this...

dialogue.origin: それは嫌だなと
dialogue.content: And I don't want that.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね、せっかく好きになった人には絶対気持ち伝えたいですよね、、
dialogue.content: I understand. When you finally find someone you like, you definitely want to tell them how you feel.

dialogue.origin: でも受験もあるし、、
dialogue.content: But you have exams to think about, too...

dialogue.origin: はい、そうなんです私はわかって欲しいと思います。でも、タイミングもこんななので、相手に負担かけたり、嫌われたりするのはやっぱり心配です。
dialogue.content: Yes, that's right. I want him to know how I feel. But with the timing being what it is, I’m worried about being a burden to him or being disliked.

dialogue.origin: 自分の思いもあるけど、相手のこと気にかけておられるのですね、、それは本当にすごいと思いますよ
dialogue.content: Even though you have your own feelings, you’re also considerate of his. I think that’s truly admirable.

dialogue.origin: いえいえ嫌われるのは一番避けたいだけです。
dialogue.content: No, not at all. I just want to avoid being disliked more than anything.

dialogue.origin: 好きになった人だから、関係を大切にしたいですよね、、
dialogue.content: Because you like him, you want to cherish any potential relationship, right?

dialogue.origin: はい、やっぱりうまくいきたいですよね。
dialogue.content: Yes, of course, I really want it to work out.

dialogue.origin: そうですね、なんとかうまく気持ちを伝えたいですよね、、その方とは塾のクラスとかは別なのでしょうか
dialogue.content: That's right. You want to find a way to convey your feelings successfully. Are you in a different class from him at cram school?

dialogue.origin: クラスは一緒です。
dialogue.content: We’re in the same class.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね、じゃあ塾ではいつも会うし思いが募りますよね、、
dialogue.content: I see. Then you must see him all the time at cram school, and your feelings must be growing stronger.

dialogue.origin: そうなんです。
dialogue.content: Yes, they are.

dialogue.origin: みのりさんは、その人のどんなところが好きになったのでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Minori, what was it about him that you came to like?

dialogue.origin: みのりじゃないですよ。あかねですww顔は元々好みな方でした。いつも明るい感じで、友達とも仲良く話しているのを見て、いい感じだなと。
dialogue.content: I'm not Minori, I'm Akane, haha. I've always thought he was my type, looks-wise. He always seems cheerful, and seeing him talking happily with his friends made me think he's a nice person.

dialogue.origin: 大変失礼しました・・・
dialogue.content: I am so sorry...

dialogue.origin: 大丈夫ですひとめぼれな感じですね、
dialogue.content: It's okay. I guess it's kind of like love at first sight,

dialogue.origin: 結局
dialogue.content: after all.

dialogue.origin: あまりよくわかってはいないです
dialogue.content: I don't really know him well.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: でも、いい人に思えてしまって
dialogue.content: But he just seems like such a good person to me.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね、、あかねさんの中でも、はっきりとは好きな理由が無いかもしれない、、と感じているのですね、、
dialogue.content: I see. So you feel that, even to yourself, you might not have a clear reason for liking him.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね。話してないので、見ているだけの思いです。
dialogue.content: That's right. Since we haven't talked, my feelings are just based on watching him.

dialogue.origin: 見ているだけで、何か想像を膨らませて好きかもしれないって感じなのでしょうか
dialogue.content: So from just watching him, your imagination fills in the gaps and you feel like you might like him—is that how it is?

dialogue.origin: 想像はいろいろしますが、でも、見ていると友達とのやりとりが、いい感じだなと思います。それって重要なところかなと。普段の姿を見てる気がします。
dialogue.content: I do imagine a lot of things, but when I watch him, the way he interacts with his friends seems really nice. I feel like that's an important quality. It feels like I’m seeing his real, everyday self.

dialogue.origin: なるほど、友達とのやり取りを見ていて、ちゃんと彼の素のいいところを発見できている感じなのですね
dialogue.content: I see, so by watching his interactions with friends, you feel you've been able to discover his genuine good qualities.

dialogue.origin: そうだとおもいます。ありがとうございます。
dialogue.content: I think so. Thank you.

dialogue.origin: うんうん、本当に彼はやさしくて、いい人なのかもしれないですね。そういう人なら本当に好きになってしまいますよね
dialogue.content: Mm-hmm, he might really be a kind and good person. It's easy to fall for someone like that, isn't it?

dialogue.origin: そうなんです。みていると、なんか、いいなと。
dialogue.content: Exactly. When I watch him, I just think, 'He seems so nice.'

dialogue.origin: なんだか、お話聞いているだけでいい人だな~というのが伝わってきます！
dialogue.content: Somehow, just from listening to you talk about him, I get the sense that he's a wonderful person!

dialogue.origin: そうですかありがとうございます。
dialogue.content: You think so? Thank you.

dialogue.origin: うんうん
dialogue.content: Mm-hm.

dialogue.origin: ちなみに、あかねさんの受験勉強の方はどんな感じですか
dialogue.content: By the way, Akane, how are your studies for the entrance exams going?

dialogue.origin: はい、それなりにはできていると思います。志望校も今の所大丈夫そうです。。
dialogue.content: Yes, I think I'm doing reasonably well. My target school seems okay for now, too.

dialogue.origin: そうでしたか、好きな人もいて、そして勉強もちゃんと頑張っておられてすごいと思います
dialogue.content: I see. I think it's amazing that you have someone you like and you're also working so hard on your studies.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます。
dialogue.content: Thank you.

dialogue.origin: ちなみに塾の方はいつぐらいまで続くのでしょうか
dialogue.content: By the way, until when does the cram school run?

dialogue.origin: 2月で終わりだったと思います。
dialogue.content: I think it ends in February.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね、あと二ヶ月ですね
dialogue.content: I see, so that's two more months.

dialogue.origin: はい。。。
dialogue.content: Yes...

dialogue.origin: その間に何とか思いを伝えたいということですね
dialogue.content: And you want to somehow convey your feelings within that time.

dialogue.origin: わかって欲しいのですが伝えたいようなだめなような・・・
dialogue.content: I want him to know, but I feel like I should tell him, and at the same time, like I shouldn't...

dialogue.origin: うんうん、彼を大切に思うからこそ余計にそんな気持ちになりますよね、、
dialogue.content: Mm-hmm. It's precisely because you care about him so much that you feel that way even more strongly, isn't it?

dialogue.origin: そういうことですかね。彼に負担にはなってほしくないとは思います。
dialogue.content: I guess so. I really don't want to be a burden to him.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね、、悩んでしまいますよね、、ここまでのお話を少しまとめさせてもらってもいいでしょうか？
dialogue.content: I understand... it's a difficult situation, isn't it? Would it be alright if I summarize what we've talked about so far?

dialogue.origin: はい、お願いします。
dialogue.content: Yes, please.

dialogue.origin: 前の彼氏と別れてしまって、これはだめだと新しい恋を探しておられました
dialogue.content: After breaking up with your ex-boyfriend, you felt you couldn't stay that way and decided to look for a new love to move on.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 同じ塾の人で、話したことはないけど、友達と話しているのを見ているととても優しくて、いい人に思える彼を好きになっています
dialogue.content: You've fallen for a boy in your cram school whom you've never spoken to, but who seems very kind and like a good person from watching him interact with his friends.

dialogue.origin: はい、そうです。
dialogue.content: Yes, that's right.

dialogue.origin: でも、受験のことを考えると本当に彼に思いを伝えていいのか？とても悩んでおられます
dialogue.content: However, when you think about the entrance exams, you're very conflicted about whether it's truly okay to tell him how you feel.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: お話をお聞きしていて、あかねさんはとても相手の彼のことを思いやることのできるとても心優しい方だと思いました。そして自分の勉強もしっかりしている頑張り屋だと思いました
dialogue.content: Listening to your story, I feel that you, Akane, are a very kind-hearted person who is very considerate of him. I also think you're a hard worker who is taking your studies seriously.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます。
dialogue.content: Thank you.

dialogue.origin: ただ、今が受験の時期であることを考えると思い切った行動に出ていいものか 、相手に負担をかけてしまうのではないかととても悩んでおられます
dialogue.content: However, considering it's exam season, you're very worried about whether it's right to make a bold move, and whether you might be burdening him.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: そこで、ご提案なのですが
dialogue.content: With that in mind, I have a suggestion.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Okay.

dialogue.origin: 今現在はまだお話したことがないとのことなので、まずはお話しする間柄になれることを目指すのはいかがでしょうか
dialogue.content: Since you mentioned you haven't spoken to him yet, how about first aiming to get to a point where you can talk to each other?

dialogue.origin: そうですよね
dialogue.content: That makes sense.

dialogue.origin: まずは、塾に行ったときに本当に一言でもいいと思うんですね、挨拶をしてみるとかだけでも相手との関わりを作るのが第一歩です　いかがですか？
dialogue.content: To start, I think even a single word when you go to cram school would be good. Just trying to say hello could be the first step to creating a connection. What do you think?

dialogue.origin: 挨拶ですか・・・そうですね。うーん今更急にってかんじなんですよね。
dialogue.content: A greeting...? I see. Hmm... it feels kind of sudden to just start doing that now.

dialogue.origin: 何か彼との接点はありますか？共通の友人とか、小学校時代のお話とか、好きなものとか
dialogue.content: Do you have any point of connection with him? A mutual friend, maybe you went to the same elementary school, or have similar interests?

dialogue.origin: それが、本当に全然ないんですよね。
dialogue.content: That's the thing, there's really nothing at all.

dialogue.origin: 振られたのがきっかけとはいえ、難しい人好きになってしまいましたよね。
dialogue.content: Even though the breakup was the catalyst, I've gone and fallen for a difficult person, haven't I?

dialogue.origin: いえいえ、そんことないと思いますよ
dialogue.content: No, no, I don't think that's true at all.

dialogue.origin: あかねさんがちゃんと見て好きになったひとですもの
dialogue.content: He's someone you came to like after really observing him, after all.

dialogue.origin: まずはそのまま彼のいいところを観察するところから進めて行ってもいいかと思いました
dialogue.content: I was thinking that, for now, perhaps you could start by just continuing to observe his good qualities as you have been.

dialogue.origin: はい。そうですね。受験終わるまで待ったほうがいいですかね。
dialogue.content: Yes, that's true. Maybe I should wait until the exams are over?

dialogue.origin: きっとどこかのタイミングで彼との接点が出来るチャンスがくると思うのですそして、思いを伝えるタイミングですが、、
dialogue.content: I'm sure a chance to connect with him will come at some point. And as for the right time to tell him your feelings...

dialogue.origin: そうならいいですが。。
dialogue.content: I hope so...

dialogue.origin: 接点をつくるのが本当に難しいですよね、、
dialogue.content: It's truly difficult to create a connection, isn't it?

dialogue.origin: 学校が違うので、それが本当にむずかしくかんじます。
dialogue.content: We go to different schools, so that makes it feel really difficult.

dialogue.origin: うんうん、残りの二か月を好きな人と勉強が出来るととらえるとまた違って見えると思うのですがいかがでしょうか。苦しい勉強も楽しく乗り越えられるという感じで。
dialogue.content: Mm-hmm. I think if you reframe it as, 'I get to study with the person I like for the next two months,' it might look different. How does that sound? It might help you get through the tough studying more enjoyably.

dialogue.origin: そうですねそういう考え方で過ごすのは、いいかもしれないです。
dialogue.content: You're right. Spending the time with that mindset might be a good idea.

dialogue.origin: そうですね、今はそうやって彼を見守りながら、自分の勉強も頑張りながら、
dialogue.content: That's right. For now, just watch over him like that while also doing your best with your own studies, and...

dialogue.origin: あと2ヶ月ですね楽しむようにしてみます。
dialogue.content: Two more months. I’ll try to enjoy it.

dialogue.origin: いろいろ聞いていただいてありがとうございました。
dialogue.content: Thank you for listening to everything.

dialogue.origin: そうですね、きっと彼のことしっかり見ているあかねさんならそうしたチャンスもおとずれると思います
dialogue.content: Yes. I'm sure that since you're watching him so carefully, Akane, a chance like that will come your way.

dialogue.origin: はい、こちらこそ有難うございました
dialogue.content: Yes, thank you as well.

dialogue.origin: 祈ります。
dialogue.content: I’ll keep my fingers crossed.

dialogue.origin: はい、私も心から応援しております！
dialogue.content: Yes, and I'll be cheering for you with all my heart!

dialogue.origin: これで相談終了してよろしいでしょうか
dialogue.content: Shall we conclude the session here?

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます。はい大丈夫です。
dialogue.content: Thank you. Yes, that's fine.

dialogue.origin: 本日は相談に来ていただきどうも有難うございました
dialogue.content: Thank you very much for coming in for a consultation today.

dialogue.origin: （お疲れさまでした！時間オーバーして本当にすみませんでした）
dialogue.content: (Great job! I'm really sorry for going over time.)

dialogue.origin: （こちらこそありがとうございました）
dialogue.content: (Thank you as well.)

dialogue.origin: （本当に勉強になりました。どうも有難うございました！）
dialogue.content: (This was a great learning experience. Thank you very much!)

dialogue.origin: （それでは失礼いたします）
dialogue.content: (Well then, I'll be taking my leave.)

topic.sub: 好きな人に告白するタイミングの悩み
